g.text: Pokus Infrastructure Installer
Uninstall progress
Uninstall finished, but kept items it could not remove; the report names each.
1 failed, 13 kept, 1 pending, 58 removed, 5 restored
Could not remove:
researcher1: researcher1 is logged in or runs processes; end them and run uninstall again
Reboot the host: uninstall never reboots.
the initramfs was rebuilt without pinka's nouveau blacklist or NVIDIA driver
Afterwards:
- /var/lib/pinka-kept holds the restic repository's password and location and the SFTP key of the backup server:
they grant access to the backups. Copy it off this host, then delete it securely, as root: tar -C /var/lib -cf -
pinka-kept | ssh <you>@<safe-host> 'umask 077; cat > pinka-kept.tar' (or copy it to removable media), then find
/var/lib/pinka-kept -type f -exec shred -u {} + && rm -rf /var/lib/pinka-kept. On an SSD or a copy-on-write file
system (btrfs) shred cannot reach every old copy: then also change the repository's password (restic key passwd,
from the copy) and replace the SFTP key on the backup server.
- Delete the node pinka-lab (192.0.2.20) in the Tailscale admin console (Machines): uninstall logs it out, which
does not take it off the tailnet.
- Revoke the platform's read-only deploy key SHA256:examplefingerprint on the Git host of the platform's
repository: uninstall removes its private half from this host.
The kept backups open with the key and settings in /var/lib/pinka-kept/backup/secrets (root only;
/var/lib/pinka-kept/README.txt says how).
/opt/pinka goes when you close the installer, which runs from it.
Kept:
/etc/pinka/secrets/backup: the restic repository's location, its password and the SFTP key: copied to
/var/lib/pinka-kept/backup/secrets (root only) before the path goes
/etc/pinka/backup: the backup helper's settings and the backup server's host keys: copied to
/var/lib/pinka-kept/backup/config (root only) before the path goes
/var/lib/pinka/backup: the state of the last backup: copied to /var/lib/pinka-kept/backup/state (root only) before
the path goes
/etc/pinka/qa: the QA trusted keys and the attestations: copied to /var/lib/pinka-kept/qa (root only) before the
path goes
